The '''2011–12 Texas Longhorns men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Texas at Austin]] in the [[2011–12 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. Their head coach was [[Rick Barnes]], who was in his 14th year. The team played its home games at the [[Frank Erwin Center]] in [[Austin, TX|Austin]], [[Texas]] and are members of the [[Big 12 Conference]]. They finished the season 20–14, 9–9 in Big 12 play to finish in sixth place. They lost in the semifinals of the [[2012 Big 12 men's basketball tournament|Big 12 Basketball tournament]] to Missouri. They received an at-large bid to the [[2012 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|2012 NCAA tournament]] where they lost in the second round to Cincinnati.
